"""
Nezavisan test set za Fazu 4 (distribucija) — Lampcutter
Autor: agy (verifikaciona nit / crveni tim)
Izvori istine: LAMPCUTTER_SPEC.md (16, Faza 4) i docs/api-phase4.md
"""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import os
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib
import zipfile
import pytest
import yaml

import lampcutter
import lampcutter.cli


def find_repo_root() -> pathlib.Path:
    cur = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    for p in [cur, cur.parent, cur.parent.parent]:
        if (p / "pyproject.toml").is_file():
            return p
    return cur


ROOT = find_repo_root()


def load_build_module():
    script_path = ROOT / "scripts" / "build.py"
    assert script_path.is_file(), f"Nedostaje scripts/build.py: {script_path}"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("build_script", script_path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


# ============================================================================
# 1. Verzija i ulazne tačke (spec 16, api-phase4)
# ============================================================================

def test_version_module():
    assert re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$", lampcutter.__version__) is not None

def test_version_pyproject_match():
    pyproj_path = ROOT / "pyproject.toml"
    assert pyproj_path.is_file()
    data = tomllib.loads(pyproj_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert data["project"]["version"] == lampcutter.__version__

def test_cli_version_flag_exits_zero(capsys):
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
        lampcutter.cli.main(["--version"])
    assert exc.value.code == 0
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert f"lampcutter {lampcutter.__version__}" in captured.out

def test_python_m_lampcutter_version_subprocess():
    res = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "lampcutter", "--version"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
    )
    assert res.returncode == 0
    combined = res.stdout + res.stderr
    assert f"lampcutter {lampcutter.__version__}" in combined

def test_cli_help_contains_all_commands(capsys):
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
        lampcutter.cli.main(["--help"])
    assert exc.value.code == 0
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    out = captured.out.lower()
    for cmd in ["run", "calibrate", "export", "gui", "benchmark"]:
        assert cmd in out

def test_project_scripts_entrypoint():
    data = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert data["project"]["scripts"]["lampcutter"] == "lampcutter.cli:main"


# ============================================================================
# 2. scripts/build.py: funkcije, tagovi i komanda (api-phase4)
# ============================================================================

def test_build_module_loads():
    mod = load_build_module()
    for fn in ["project_version", "platform_tag", "build_command", "make_archive", "main"]:
        assert hasattr(mod, fn)

def test_build_project_version():
    mod = load_build_module()
    assert mod.project_version() == lampcutter.__version__

def test_build_platform_tag():
    mod = load_build_module()
    tag = mod.platform_tag()
    assert isinstance(tag, str)
    assert "-" in tag
    os_name, arch = tag.split("-", 1)
    assert os_name in ("linux", "macos", "windows")
    assert arch in ("x86_64", "arm64", "amd64", "aarch64")

def test_build_command_default_onedir():
    mod = load_build_module()
    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir="/tmp/dist", work_dir="/tmp/work", onefile=False)
    cmd = mod.build_command(args)
    assert "-m" in cmd
    assert "PyInstaller" in cmd
    assert "--noconfirm" in cmd
    assert "--clean" in cmd
    assert "--name" in cmd
    assert "lampcutter" in cmd
    assert "--distpath" in cmd
    assert "--workpath" in cmd
    assert "--paths" in cmd
    assert "--collect-submodules" in cmd
    assert "lampcutter" in cmd
    assert "--console" in cmd
    assert cmd[-1].endswith("__main__.py")
    assert "--onefile" not in cmd

def test_build_command_onefile():
    mod = load_build_module()
    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir="/tmp/dist", work_dir="/tmp/work", onefile=True)
    cmd = mod.build_command(args)
    assert "--onefile" in cmd

def test_build_command_translations_data():
    mod = load_build_module()
    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir="/tmp/dist", work_dir="/tmp/work", onefile=False)
    cmd = mod.build_command(args)
    if mod.TRANSLATIONS_DIR.is_dir():
        assert "--add-data" in cmd

# ============================================================================
# 2b. scripts/build.py: dry-run, make_archive i greške (api-phase4)
# ============================================================================

def test_build_main_dry_run_exits_zero(capsys):
    mod = load_build_module()
    ret = mod.main(["--dry-run"])
    assert ret == 0
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "PyInstaller" in captured.out

def test_build_main_dry_run_does_not_call_subprocess(monkeypatch):
    mod = load_build_module()
    called = []
    def fake_run(*args, **kwargs):
        called.append(True)
        raise RuntimeError("subprocess.run ne sme biti pozvan pri --dry-run")
    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "run", fake_run)
    ret = mod.main(["--dry-run"])
    assert ret == 0
    assert called == []

def test_build_make_archive_onedir(tmp_path):
    mod = load_build_module()
    dist = tmp_path / "dist"
    bundle = dist / "lampcutter"
    bundle.mkdir(parents=True)
    (bundle / "binary_file").write_text("mock binary", encoding="utf-8")
    sub = bundle / "resources"
    sub.mkdir()
    (sub / "data.txt").write_text("mock data", encoding="utf-8")

    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir=str(dist), onefile=False)
    zip_path = mod.make_archive(args)
    assert zip_path.is_file()
    assert zip_path.name == f"lampcutter-{mod.project_version()}-{mod.platform_tag()}.zip"

    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
        names = z.namelist()
        assert any("binary_file" in n for n in names)
        assert any("data.txt" in n for n in names)

def test_build_make_archive_onefile(tmp_path):
    mod = load_build_module()
    dist = tmp_path / "dist_onefile"
    dist.mkdir(parents=True)
    exe_name = "lampcutter.exe" if sys.platform == "win32" else "lampcutter"
    (dist / exe_name).write_text("mock executable", encoding="utf-8")

    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir=str(dist), onefile=True)
    zip_path = mod.make_archive(args)
    assert zip_path.is_file()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
        assert exe_name in z.namelist()

def test_build_make_archive_missing_output_raises_filenotfound(tmp_path):
    mod = load_build_module()
    args = argparse.Namespace(name="lampcutter", dist_dir=str(tmp_path / "non_existent"), onefile=False)
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        mod.make_archive(args)


# ============================================================================
# 3. GitHub Workflows: CI i Release (api-phase4)
# ============================================================================

def test_ci_workflow_valid_yaml():
    ci_path = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"
    assert ci_path.is_file()
    data = yaml.safe_load(ci_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert "jobs" in data and "test" in data["jobs"]

def test_ci_workflow_fetch_depth_zero():
    ci = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    steps = ci["jobs"]["test"]["steps"]
    checkout = next(s for s in steps if "actions/checkout" in s.get("uses", ""))
    assert checkout.get("with", {}).get("fetch-depth") == 0

def test_ci_workflow_uv_sync_dependencies():
    ci = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    steps = ci["jobs"]["test"]["steps"]
    runs = " ".join(s.get("run", "") for s in steps)
    assert "uv sync --group dev --extra gui" in runs

def test_ci_workflow_runs_five_suites():
    ci = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    steps = ci["jobs"]["test"]["steps"]
    runs = " ".join(s.get("run", "") for s in steps)
    for suite in ["phase0a", "phase0b", "phase1", "phase2", "phase3"]:
        assert suite in runs

def test_release_workflow_valid_yaml_and_trigger():
    rel_path = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "release.yml"
    assert rel_path.is_file()
    rel = yaml.safe_load(rel_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert rel.get("on", {}).get("push", {}).get("tags") == ["v*"]
    assert rel.get("permissions", {}).get("contents") == "write"

def test_release_workflow_jobs_and_matrix():
    rel = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "release.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert "build" in rel["jobs"]
    assert "release" in rel["jobs"]
    assert rel["jobs"]["release"]["needs"] == "build"
    matrix = rel["jobs"]["build"]["strategy"]["matrix"]["include"]
    os_list = [m["os"] for m in matrix]
    assert "ubuntu-latest" in os_list
    assert "macos-latest" in os_list
    assert "windows-latest" in os_list

def test_release_workflow_steps():
    rel = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "release.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    build_steps = rel["jobs"]["build"]["steps"]
    checkout = next(s for s in build_steps if "actions/checkout" in s.get("uses", ""))
    assert checkout.get("with", {}).get("fetch-depth") == 0
    build_runs = " ".join(s.get("run", "") for s in build_steps)
    assert "scripts/build.py --archive" in build_runs
    upload = next(s for s in build_steps if "actions/upload-artifact" in s.get("uses", ""))
    assert "dist/*.zip" in upload.get("with", {}).get("path", "")

    release_steps = rel["jobs"]["release"]["steps"]
    gh_release = next(s for s in release_steps if "softprops/action-gh-release" in s.get("uses", ""))
    assert "dist/*.zip" in gh_release.get("with", {}).get("files", "")

# 4. docs/INSTALACIJA.md & pyproject.toml validacije (spec 16, api-phase4)
# ============================================================================

def test_docs_installation_exists():
    doc_path = ROOT / "docs" / "INSTALACIJA.md"
    assert doc_path.is_file()

def test_docs_installation_headings():
    content = (ROOT / "docs" / "INSTALACIJA.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
    expected_topics = [
        "preuzimanje",
        "gatekeeper",
        "linux",
        "prvi koraci",
        "ml stack",
        "iz izvora",
        "build",
        "rešavanje problema",
    ]
    for topic in expected_topics:
        assert topic in content

def test_docs_installation_key_commands():
    content = (ROOT / "docs" / "INSTALACIJA.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for cmd in ["--version", "calibrate", "run", "--mask-file", "gui", "xattr"]:
        assert cmd in content

def test_docs_installation_archive_naming():
    content = (ROOT / "docs" / "INSTALACIJA.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "lampcutter-" in content
    assert ".zip" in content

def test_pyproject_gui_extra_pins_pyside6():
    pyproj = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    gui_deps = pyproj["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["gui"]
    assert any("PySide6==" in d and "6.12.0" in d for d in gui_deps)

def test_pyproject_dev_dependencies():
    pyproj = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    dev_deps = pyproj["dependency-groups"]["dev"]
    dev_names = [d.split("==")[0].lower() for d in dev_deps]
    assert "pyinstaller" in dev_names
    assert "pytest-qt" in dev_names
    assert "pyyaml" in dev_names
